edition.authority: The Latin title at PDF page 510 states superiorum permissu. The approval at PDF page 6, dated 15 October 1905 and signed Aloysius Pareparambil, Bishop of Tiana and Vicar Apostolic of Ernakulam, refers to his permission of 10 June 1904 and to appended new Masses approved by the Sacred Congregation of Rites on 31 July 1905. The cited Congregation act has not been independently inspected.

edition.title: Ordo chaldaicus rituum et lectionum juxta morem Ecclesiae Malabaricae
